## Look

engage accepts a triaged idea, reads it, and routes to settle-phase (idea with an effort) or init (idea without one), carrying the idea on the routing line. init and settle-phase promote the idea after they create the effort or phase. Read the skill diffs and the check-runs for the routing and contract tests.
